Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You cite market increases, yet your earlier letter confirms fixed-price alloy cover; it seems the key issue is when market movements actually reach your costs. We value the partnership and want a demonstrable cost basis, with payment timing and contract duration supporting planning certainty. Following your offer to review the calculation, what cost-breakdown XLSX can you share showing material and conversion costs separately and how the fixed-price cover affects them?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Using your own cost shares (AS-14404 45%, LCI-C 5%, PPI-C2431 38%) and the latest six-month index moves (AS-14404 -0.3% (idx:AS-14404@2026-03, idx:AS-14404@2026-09), LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2431 +9.7%), your cost increase comes to about +3.6% of the price, not +11.0%. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.73 per unit, no index clause, 45 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.70 per unit, no index clause, 14 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.72 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month volume, which allows us to improve our pricing.
Because our AS-14404 supply is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, recent index fluctuations do not reduce our actual costs, and as a matter of policy, we do not share internal cost breakdowns.
To support the requested 24-month contract duration, we must include an AS-14404 index clause, for which we can offer €5.51 per unit with 30 days payment.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You emphasise fixed-price alloy coverage while making index protection a condition of a longer contract; it sounds like managing future cost exposure is central to your position. We can recognise that interest if the base price reflects both our commitment and the risk transferred to us. How can you turn that protection into a stronger base-price concession?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +3.6%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.82 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 0% deadband), 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

It sounds like recovering non-alloy costs is your central concern: you distinguish those costs from the future alloy risk, while your earlier letter confirms that alloy purchases remain covered at fixed prices. We want a defensible base price and risk sharing that reflects when your costs actually change. How can you substantiate the requested base price through the cost-breakdown spreadsheet your owner offered to discuss, separating covered material costs from the other cost drivers?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +3.6%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.91 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 0% deadband), 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
